items.text: Jets ruled out RB Breece Hall (quad) again for Week 6 vs Patriots; third straight miss. Adonai Mitchell also OUT.
items.implication: Full snaps/carries to Braelon Allen (90% in prior games per Levitan).

items.text: Texans RB David Montgomery (groin), WR Tank Dell (knee), S Jalen Pitre (shoulder) will not travel to London and ruled OUT vs Jaguars.
items.implication: Full snaps to Woody Marks (98% prior); Marks low-end RB2.

items.text: Jalen Hurts ruled out for Week 6 vs Panthers due to superficial blood clot in calf that showed movement on follow-up ultrasound; out indefinitely pending treatment (possibly thinners). Tanner McKee to start; Eagles added Joe Milton from Cowboys PS for depth.
items.why: Movement in clot after London game clearance; health priority.
items.implication: McKee start downgrades Eagles offense efficiency/red-zone; Saquon/DeVonta/Goedert still viable but lower ceiling.
items.opportunity: Backup QB volume if any; handcuff Eagles skill if available.

items.text: Saquon Barkley no practice again Thursday (hamstring); DeVonta Smith upgraded to limited (toe).
items.implication: Game-time or limited; Kenny Gainwell upside if sits. Smith trending up.
items.opportunity: Gainwell if OUT; Smith routes/targets rebound.

items.text: Chiefs WR Rashee Rice DNP again Thursday (hamstring); remains sidelined post-bye.
items.implication: Worthy/Kelce upside elevated; Rice GTD or OUT risk.

items.text: Lamar Jackson DNP Thursday (ankle); has 'realistic chance' to play Sunday vs Browns per sources. Huntley would start otherwise.
items.why: Ankle from Oct 4; progressing but not practicing.
items.implication: Flowers/Andrews ceiling higher if plays; monitor Friday.
items.opportunity: If OUT, Huntley caps skill upside slightly.

items.text: Caleb Williams full participant again Thursday (hamstring); still needs clearance but trending toward return vs Falcons.
items.implication: QB8-range upside vs ATL pass D; Odunze/Burden/Moore boost.

items.text: Berry LOVES Rhamondre Stevenson RB9 vs NYJ; volume spike with Henderson multi-week high-ankle out (85% snaps/23 touches prior).
items.why: Henderson out multi-week; proven high-touch PPG.

items.text: Levitan notes RB snaps since Breece injury: Braelon Allen 90, Isaiah Davis 12, Nwangwu 0. Full to Allen.
items.implication: Allen locked RB2 while Hall out.

items.text: Levitan: Eagles gold standard moving on from aging stars early (Dawkins/McNabb/McCoy/Ertz). Saquon turns 30 in Feb; Super Bowl contenders with RB need should call now. Worth risk of year-too-early.
items.implication: Trade-value peak warning; monitor role post-injury.
items.conflict: Still elite if healthy, but timeline risk.

items.text: Matthew Berry LOVES Mike Evans as WR4 vs WSH; Commanders D is buffet for pass catchers. Season-high target share last week, Deebo out multi-week.
items.why: Target share spike, soft matchup, depth chart thin behind him.

items.text: Berry LOVES Drake London WR6 vs CHI; bankable usage in favorable spot.
Berry LOVES Kyren Williams RB5 vs ARI; elite recent usage vs leaky run D.
Berry HATES Jaylen Waddle WR28 vs SEA; ugly matchup + inconsistent production (most yards in one game).
items.why: Seattle D problem + low yards outside one outlier.
items.implication: Sit/fade despite return from shoulder in TNF.
items.conflict: Returned ACTIVE mid-TNF after Q shoulder.
